MU baker windowmaster whipstock associated BHA TIH.
Finished RIH with baker windowmaster whipstock. Oriented set same. Cut window from 2202-2207 m. Drilled 6 m of formation. POOH for drilling BHA.
TIH with drilling BHA to 9 5/8" window. Corrected problem w/yellow pod tested bops. Attempted to drill-got stuck freed string. Unable to pass back through window. POOH PU milling BHA.
Tried to mill through 9 5/8" window-unsuccessful. POOH with milling BHA TIH with 9 5/8" bridge-plug. Set same at 2187m. POOH MU 2nd baker windowmaster whipstock.
Set 2nd whipstock milled window from 2178-2183 m. Drilled 19 m formation. Circulated hole clean POOH to MU drilling BHA.
Finished handling milling BHA. MU TIH with drilling BHA to TD. Drilled from 2202 2405 m. Sliding as directional program required to drop angle turn hole toward objective.
Directionally drill 8 1/2" hole from 2405 2768 m. Problems with achieving desired azimuth/turn.
Circulated hole clean. POOH set motor at 1,5 degrees PU insert bit. TIH to drill ahead-to turn hole to right. Ran gyro survey inside drillstring. Started drilling 8 1/2" hole.

Drilled 8 1/2" hole from 2771-2783 m not making progress. POOH for bit/bha change got stuck while preparing to pull through window. Fight lost returns/tight hole. Successful in pulling through window. Finished POOH. Test bops.
TIH to TD to determine hole's condition. Cavings to surface after bu. Increase mud WT. To 1,54 SG. POOH for drilling BHA.
RIH. Drilled and oriented 8 1/2" hole from 2783 3052 m.
Drilled 8 1/2" hole from 3052-3057 m. Circulated hole clean short tripped to 2707 m no problems on short trip. Circulated tripped for new bit BHA change. Started drilling 8 1/2" hole.
Drilled 8 1/2" hole from 3057 3379 m. Circulated to reduce hole drag. Drilled from 3379 3390 m.
Drilled 8 1/2'' hole from 3390 3573 m. Circulating as required to clean hole
Drill to 3632m. Circ and POOH and change BHA. RIH to shoe and routine cut drilling line.
Continue RIH to BTM. Drilled oriented f/3632 3653m. MWD failed to communicate to surface. POOH and changed MWD. RIH to 3085m.
Cont RIH. Orient and drill for corepoint.
Drill for core point, negative result. POOH, change bit, function test BOP. Continued RIH.
Comleted bit change trip and drilled to corepoint at 3837m. Circ with positive hydrocarbons indications. POOH and picked up coring BHA. RIH.
Completed reaming to TD. Cut core no 1 m). Currently POOH with core.
POOH and laid down core no 1, 95 recovery. Made up corebarrel and RIH and cut core no 2, 3854 3881m. Start to POOH.
Retrived core no 2, 100 recovery. RIH and cut core no 3. Circ down gas level and poh to current depth 1412m.
Retrieved core no 3. 99,6 recovery. Cut core no 4. Circ down gas gas level and poh to current depth 1195m.
Recovered core no 4. RIH and cutted core no 5. Circulated BTM up. POOH. Started to retrieve core no 5.
Recovered core no 5, 102 recovery. RIH and cut core no 6. POOH and recovered core. 100,5 recovery. Changed bit and RIH to cut core no 7.
Continued RIH. Reamed tight hole to core point. Cutted core no 7. Started poh.
Retrieved core no 7 98. 9 recovery. Laid down corbarrel. Tested BOP changed uibop and actuator. Made up drilling BHA and started RIH.
Continued RIH, logged cored intervall, started drilling from 4017m to 4087m.
Drilled 8 1/2" hole from 4087m to 4131m. Circulated for logs. POOH. R/u atlas and attempted to log. Tool stood up at 2755m. Log out of hole from 2755m.
Finished first log run. Ran VSP tool stood up at 2762m. Logged out VSP from 2762m. R/u to run logs on drill pipe. Repaired top drive. R/u and ran logs on drill pipe.
Logged 8 1/2" hole on drill pipe.
Logged 8 1/2" hole on drill pipe.
Logged 8 1/2" hole on drill pipe.
Logged 8 1/2" hole on drill pipe. Operations suspended due for 4 hours due to industrial action. Now RIH with logging tools on drill pipe to casing window.
RIH to 2168m with logging tools on drill pipe. Operations suspended due to industrial action.
Operations suspended due to industrial action. Continued RIH with logging tools on drill pipe. Pipe stuck with logging tools at 4123m. Worked pipe. POOH with wireline.
Finished POOH with wireline. Freed stuck pipe. POOH and l/d logging tools. RIH for wiper trip to condition hole for running 7" casing.
Made wiper trip to condition hole for running 7" casing. R/u to run 7" casing.
R/u and ran 7" casing.
Finished running 7" casing. Circulated and cemented casing. Set seal assembly.
Seal assembly failed to test. Attemped to reset w/o success. Pulled seal assembly. Cleaned sealing area in wellhead with mill/flush tool. Set and tested new seal assembly. Tested BOP. P/u 3 1/2" DP.
Well secured using hang-off-tool. 7" casing b/s rams tested to 345 bar. Rig operations suspended due to ofs strike.

Displaced riser to OBM. Screwed into hang-off tool and circulated bottoms up. POOH.
Tested BOP. LD 5" DP from derrick.
PU 3 1/2" DP from deck. LD 5" HWDP and 6 1/2" DC. RIH to 3820 m. Worked CSG scraper.
RIH to pb depth. Circulated and conditioned mud. POOH. RU to RIH with SBT log.
Run SBT log. Rig down wireline.
Rigged down logging equipment. Made clean-up/mud condition run inside 7" casing to hight tension while logging). Reduced mudweight from 1,55 SG to 1,47 SG. Started to pull out of hole.
Pulled out of hole with 5-7/8" bit and 7" casing scraper. Ran atlas log no. 2b mac-gr. Ran atlas perforating guns on wireline.
Perforated 7" casing levels) on atlas wireline. Pulled out. Found upper 3 levels not fired. Worked to solve problem. Made up and ran in hole with atlas perforating assembly.
Perforated addotional 2 levels inside 7" casing 3. Level due to correlation problems). Made up schlumberger MDT tool string. Worked to solve contact problems on same.
Ran schlumberger MDT log on drill-pipe. Had failure on cable contact with MDT assembly. Worked to solve problem.
Pulled out of hole with schlumberger MDT logging assembly. Changed out damaged part. Ran in hole with MDT tool string on drill pipe to 3600 m.
Not able to get proper signals from schlumberger MDT tool. Pulled out with same. Modified MDT tool string. Ran in hole to 3604 m. Ran locomotive on atlas wireline.
Tested MDT tool. Unable to operate chamber valve. Circulated and conditioned mud. POOH. R/u atlas and RIH with perforating guns on wireline.
POOH with atlas perforating guns. Tested BOP. R/u subsurface DST equipment. P/u DST BHA and RIH.
RIH with DST string.
RIH with DST string. R/u surface equipment. Pressure tested DST string and surface lines. Set packer and initiated DST of water zone.

Continued DST of water zone. RIH with bottom hole sampling tool on wireline tool failed to open. POOH with wireline. Waited on swell and heave to subside to disconnect wireline lubricator and change out sampling tools.

RIH with bottom hole sampling tool on wireline and collected water sample. Reversed out tubing contents. Circulated tubing to seawater and attempted min-frac no injection established. Reverse circulated tubing to kill mud. R/d wireline pressure control equipment and flow head.
Circulated bottoms up. POOH with DST string. RIH with EZSV retainer to plug water zone perforations.
Completed TIH with 7" EZSV. Had problems setting finally set at 3947 m. Tested EZSV. C&c mud. POOH with EZSV setting tool& DP.
Perforated DST zone using electric line. MU started running DST string.
Completed PU/MU 3 1/2" tubing. Landed string in wellhead and correlated with AWS/MWS wireline equipment.

RD electric line after making correlation run. Spaced-out DST string. MU sstt continued running DST string-testing as per plan. RU flow head landed-out hanger. Continued pressure testing. Set packer. Closed MPR. Checked for correct valving line-up.
Opened flowed well. Shut-in for downhole pressure build-up test.
Completed shut-in build-up test. Performed bottom-hole-sampling operations via electric line. Started mini-frac operations.
Completed mini-frac job. Perforated upper test zone from 3826-3865 m. Flowed/tested well.
Flowed/tested well.
Flowed/tested well. Shut-in for downhole pressure build-up test.
Shut-in for downhole pressure build-up test.
Completed shut-in pressure build-up test. Performed mini-frac/kill operations. LD flowhead, 5" landing string, sstt. Started POOH/LD 3 1/2" DST string.
Completed POOH/LD DST string. MU 7" EZSV TIH to squeeze perfs.
Completed TIH with 7" EZSV set EZSV at 3818 m. Performed squeeze job.
POOH w/7" EZSV mechanical setting tool to 2325 m LD 3 1/2" DP. Increased mud WT. To 1,55 SG. Finished POOH. Tested bops. MU started TIH with 7" casing cutter BHA.

Cont RIH and cut 7" CSG at 2275m. POOH and retrived wear bushing. Attempt to retrieve seal assy with 4 runs to wellhead, no success. Modefied spring loaded tool and retrieved seal assy. Made up 7" CSG spear assy and RIH.
Retrived 7" CSG. Set wear bushing and RIH to set kick off plug. Circ hole in CSG window.
Circulated gas level down. RIH and set kick off plug. POOH and laid down excess 3 1/2" DP and 4 3/4" DC'S
RIH and tested 9 5/8" CSG. POOH. Slip and cut drilling line while changed wash pipe. Rig transfered to well 15/9 19b at 2200 hrs.
Reporting transferred from 15/9-19b. Drilled 8 1/2'' hole from 2911 to 3042 m.
Drilled from 3042-3152 m. Trip for bit change due to hours/revolutions. Changed-out bit RIH to drill ahead,

Completed TIH to TD. Drilled from 3152 3220 m. Cbu flowchecked in preparation for toh-slight flow. Cbu taking bottoms up through choke cbu again no gas seen. Flowchecked still slight flow. Backreamed out of hole will backream until inside 9 5/8" casing.
Finished backreaming/pooh to 2163m/10 m above 9 5/8" window. Circulated until shakers were clean. Finish POOH. MU CMT. Stand. Ran 7"liner HGR.
Continued to run 7" liner on 5" DP from 1129 2849m. Tight hole ø 2849m lost returns when hole packed-off while trying to wash down. Worked/rotated down to 2901 m unable to pass. POOH with 7" liner.
Completed LD 7" liner. MU 8 1/2" wiper trip BHA TIH had to start working/washing/reaming ø 2746 m.

Completed TIH w/r to TD ø 3220 m. Circulated until shakers cleaned up. Attempted to POOH without pumping or backreaming-unable because of tight hole swabbing. Able to pull pipe above 2711 m. POOH to change bit BHA.
RIH to 3206 m with rotary BHA. POOH with wiper trip BHA wiper trip made. RU to run 7" liner.
Ran 7" liner nodeco liner hanger. Continued running liner on DP HWDP to 2593 m.
Completed running 7" liner to 3198 m. Cemented same. Tested tol 7" x 9 5/8" casing strings to 180 bar. POOH with HGR. Setting tool.
Completed POOH with liner hanger setting tool. LD excess tubulars from derrick. Ran test tool tested bops. Repair upper racking arm top drive.
POOH with BOP test tool. Completed testing surface equipment. MU 6" rotary BHA RIH to drill-out 7" liner. Drilled shoe track and cleaned out rat hole to 3201m.
Circulated ø TD. POOH for bit/bha change. MU 6" steerable BHA tripped in hole.
Completed trip to change to motor and MWD BHA. Drilled to 3317m. Multiple survey takes to get survey, continued drilling in rotating mode to 3348m. Worked to get toolface readout, no success.
Attempted to drill in oriented mode, no go due to bit stalling. POOH and changed bit and probe in MWD tool. RIH to 1900m.
Completed RIH with tricone bit, orient drilled in order to turn right and increase inclination. Tight hole in cretaceous formation. Backreamed to 3365m. POOH in order to change bit and MWD.
Change bit, navidrill and stabilizer on BHA. RIH to BTM and drilled from 3405m to 3471m.
Drilled in rotation mode from 3471m to 3511m. POOH to change BHA. Function tested BOP. Continued POOH and picked up slick motor/bha. RIH
Completed trip to change BHA. Drilled from 3511 to 3603m.

Attempted to drill in oriented mode, no go. Pump out to 3514m. Continued POOH to surface. Change tilt on navidrill, made up rock bit and serviced MWD. RIH to 2250 m. Serviced top drive, iron roughneck and standlift. Continued RIH.
Completed BHA/BIT change trip. Oriented drilling OK 3603m to 3656m. POOH to change to PDC bit and reset ako.
RIH to BTM. Precationary washed for junk at BTM, drilled from 3656m to 3690m. No MWD signals, POOH to investigate MWD failure.
Completed round trip due to MWD power failure. Re-logged previous drilled section, continued drilling from 3690m to 3708m.
Drilled 3708m to 3717m. POOH and changed bit and ako motor. RIH to BTM and drilled from 3717m to 3728m.
Drilled from 3728m to 3950m.
Drilled and circulated samples from 3950m to 4031m. Started POOH for coring.
Continued POOH. Serviced MWD. Tested BOP. Made up corebarrel and RIH.
RIH with coring assembly. While reaming down from 3680m string became stuck momentarily at 3772m and 3842m. POOH and racked backed coring assembly. P/u rotary drilling assembly. W. O. W.
Weather conditions satisfactory to resume operations. RIH to 3341m. Reamed tight hole in places from 3341m to 3960m.
Continued reaming from 3960m to TD at 4031m. Drilled 6" hole from 4031m to 4037m. Cbu for samples. POOH to p/u core barrel.
P/u core barrel and RIH. Cut core from 3037m to 3054. 5m. POOH.
Finished POOH with core L/d core recovered 12. 8m of 17. 5m cut Redressed barrel and RIH. Cut core from 4054. 5m to 4070. 5m. POOH with core
Finished POOH with core and l/d same. Recovered 17. 3m corrected TD to 4072m MD. Redressed barrel and RIH. Cut core from 4072m to 4090. 5m. POOH with core
Finished POOH with core and l/d same. Recovered 18m Redressed core barrel and RIH. Cut core from 4090m to 4109m. POOH w/ core and l/d same. Recovered 19m P/u drilling assembly.

Finished p/u 6" drilling assembly and RIH. Reamed from 4007m to 4109m to obtain MWD log. Drilled 6" hole from 4109m to 4139m. Poor MWD log quality while drilling. Reamed from 4105m to 4130m to acquire MWD log.
Finished reaming from 4130m to 4139m to aqcuire better MWD log. Drilled from 4139m to 4250m. Circulated bottoms up and boosted riser. POOH for wiper trip. Pipe stuck at 4094m. Worked stuck pipe.
Freed stuck pipe. Finished POOH. R/u AWS and ran wireline logs from 7" casing shoe 1st run mac/gr, 2nd run VSP.
Finished running VSP in casing. M/u cleanout BHA and started RIH for wiper trip. Repaired top drive. Continued RIH for wiper trip.
Finished RIH for wiper trip. Circulated bottoms up to clean hole. POOH. R/u and run logs on drill pipe.
Logged 6" hole on drill pipe and VSP).
Continued logging 6" hole on drill pipe. Finished VSP. Ran density/ neutron logs. POOH with VSP/SUPERCOMBO logging tool string on drill pipe.

Completed LD VSP/SUPERCOMBO toolstring. MU fmt toolstring RIH to 7" shoe. Side entry sub washed-out during circulation. POOH with electric line to replace side-entry sub wireline damaged. Changed out drum of atlas electric line.

Successfully ran fmt toolstring to 4200 m took pressure readings attempted sample. POOH to 7" shoe with toolstring/drillpipe. Unlatched wet connector POOH with atlas electric line. POOH with fmt toolstring.
Completed POOH LD fmt toolstring. MU RIH with sidewall core toolstring on drillpipe/pipe conveyed logging system. Started shooting sidewall cores.

Finished shooting sidewall cores via pcl techniques. POOH with sidewall coring toolstring to 7" shoe. Disconnect POOH with wet connector via electric line. RD atlas sheaves. Continued to POOH with sidewall coring toolstring/drillpipe. MU 2 7/8" cement stinger TIH to start p&a.

Monitored weather while 10 stands above 7" shoe. Weather decreasing RIH to TD with cement stinger. Started circulating weather deteriorated rapidly. POOH hang-off string. Unlatched lmrp ø 1755 hrs. Wait-on- weather.
Continued waiting-on-weather. Latched lmrp onto bops. Checked for pressure in wellbore. RIH MU drillpipe into hang-off-tool. Retrieved hang-off-tool stood back same. Circulated to balance mud.

Finished circulating mud. TIH to TD circulated mud. Spotted p&a plug from 4250-4025 m. POOH to 4025 m spotted p&a plug from 4025-3800m. POOH to 3660m circulated mud. Spotted hi-vis pill POOH to 3250 m. Spotting p&a plug from 3250-3100m.
Spotted plug number 3 from 3250-3100 m. POOH to 2940 m circulated. POOH LD tubulars on trip out of hole. MU 5 7/8" bit BHA to test plug number 3 started RIH.

Verified losing mud via riser system. Continued to RIH to 640m tested cement plug to 70 bar displaced riser to seawater. Continued RIH to cement plug number 3-tagged weight tested ø 3146m. Displaced oil base mud with water base mud because of leak in riser. Built waterbase mud to allow POOH. Started POOH with 5 7/8" bit LD 5" drillpipe.
Finished POOH with 5 7/8" bit. MU RIH with 9 5/8" casing cutting assembly. Cut casing ø 1485 m. Swept gas from stack circulated bottoms up. POOH with cutting assembly.
Pulled seal assembly. Speared 9 5/8" x 10 3/4" casing string. Bullheaded annular volume to formation. POOH-LD 10 3/4" 9 5/8" casing.
Finished LD 9 5/8" casing. RIH and spotted cement plug number 4 from 1540 1385 m. POOH to 1350 m and circulated. POOH LD 3 1/2" DP on trip out.

Finished POOH with cement muleshoe. RIH and tagged plug number 4 at 1371 m tested same. POOH. Ran 13 3/8" bridge plug on electric line dragging below 1209 m made it to 1214 m. Set bridge plug at 1209 m. POOH with electric line. MU and RIH 13 3/8" casing cutting BHA. Cut 13 3/8" casing at 211 m.

Circulated out gas from 13 3/8" casing cut at 211 m. POOH with cutter. Pulled seal assembly. Attempted to pull 13 3/8" casing unsuccessful. LD tubulars from derrick. RIH to 462 m. POOH to 350 m, LD 3 1/2" drill pipe. Spotted hi-vis pill from 350 250 m. POOH and spotted cement plug number 5 from 250 125 m. Squeeze mud/cement. Washed to 150 m and circulated bottoms up with seawater. POOH to bops. PO
Continued l/d excess tubulars from derrick. S/c drill line, rigged up and disconnected lmpr, pulled rig off location. Pulled lmpr to splash sone.
Completed trip to retrieve lmrp. Changed out worn flex jt and prepared to run lmpr.
Prepared and run in and retrived BOP. Set corrosion cap and atached protection hatch.
Complete installation of protection hatch and retrieved frame for same deballasted rig and pulled 6 anchors. Wow due to high wind.
Waited on weather to pull anchors.
Waiting on weather to pull anchors. Anchor handling. Rig on tow to ølen.
nan
Made up 8 1/2" drilling BHA, RIH. Picking up 5" DP for drilling.

Continued pick up 5" DP and RIH. Wash CMT traces to CSG window. Driller hit wooden beams underneath crown blocks. Removed wood and inspect crown blocks hrs repair time) dress CMT and performed kick off from 2231m to 2277m.
Drilled from 2268m to 2345m. Did not get planned curvature, circ and POOH. Changed bit and l/d NB stabilizer. Changed ako setting and RIH.
Drill and orient from 2350m to 2808m.

Continued drilling to 2811m. POOH changed bit and set ako from 1,4 to 1,2 degr. Pick up 5" DP whilst RIH. Function tested BOP at window. RIH and drilled in orienting and rotating mode from 2811m to 2850m.

Drilled from 2850 to 3035m. Lost returns, mixed and pumped LCM pill no significant improvement from pill. Drilled 4 m without return before spotting LCM pill. Lost 43 m3 mud to formation. Flow checked POOH to shoe, well flowed back with 14,1 m3. Attempted to establish circ. No success. POOH with reduced speed due to flow back during trip.

Continued POOH and RIH with 3 1/2" CMT stinger on 5" DP. Pump 3 m3 spacer followed 4 m3 CMT slurry. Poh to above CMT and pressure to 32 bar on plug, OK. Lost 0. 2 m3. Circ hole volume and POOH w/cmt string. Made up BHA and RIH.
Continued RIH. Set elevator on to and damaged upper pipe racking arm repaired on racking arm.

Continued repair on upper racking arm. RIH and drilled CMT from 2983m to 3039m and new hole to 3054m. Lost 42 m3 mud during drilling. Circulated BTM up. POOH to 3001m. Got 18 m3 flow back from formation. RIH to 3045m and circulated BTM up. POOH.
Continued POOH with drilling BHA. RIH with 3 1/2" CMT stinger to 2121m hung off string in wellhead and waited on weather.
Waiting on weather.
W. O. W.
W. O. W. Displaced riser to seawater and disconnected lmrp.
W. O. W.

Reconnected lmrp to BOP. POOH w/ emergency drill pipe hang off tool. RIH to bottom. Could not gain full circulation. POOH to casing window. Gained full circulation. Began washing to bottom and reducing MW.
Finished washing to bottom with cement stinger. Well started flowing. Monitored pressures and bled off same. Circulated bottoms up. Set balanced cement plug over loss zone and squeezed same. Cbu.
Slipped and cut drilling line. Finished POOH. Tested BOP. RIH with drilling BHA. Began washing to bottom from 2600 m.
Washed down from 2651m to 2920m. Washed and drilled soft to firm cement from 2920m to 3054m. Drilled 8 1/2" hole from 3054m to 3212m. No mud losses.

Drilled 8 1/2" hole from 3212m to 3272m. Began losing mud returns. Pipe started sticking. Worked and jarred pipe to 3241 where no further progress could be made. Rigged up to run stringshot to backoff pipe.
R/u atlas to run backoff tool through top drive. Atlas RIH. Backed off DP too high below wellhead)while applying left hand torque. R/d backoff string. Screwed into DP. R/u and ran severence charge.
Cut drill string at 3164m. POOH tight to 2950m. P/u cleanout assembly and RIH.
Continued RIH with cleanout assembly. Washed and reamed to top of fish. Excessive cuttings raised mud weight from 1. 49 SG to 1. 52 SG. Slight losses. POOH to p/u cement stinger for sidetrack plug.
RIH with cement stinger. Washed to bottom and circulated with reduced pump rate to maintain returns. Set sidetrack plug. POOH. P/u steerable drilling assembly.
RIH with steerable drilling assembly and washed from 2500m to 3010m with no resistance or evidence of hard cement plug. POOH to p/u cement stinger.
Completed POOH with sidetrack BHA. TIH to set sidetrack plug breaking circulation circulating as needed. Set sidetrack plug from 2983 2835 m with 0,5 m3 of mud loss. POOH with stinger.

Finished POOH with cement stinger. TIH with 8 1/2" sidetrack BHA. Tagged ø 2716m entire weight of drillstring partial weight of TDS/ block slacked-off. Drillstring plugged-unable to circulate. POOH with wet string. MU new bit motor found MWD plugged. TIH to sidetrack.
Completed RIH to 2600 m. W/r from 2600 2903 m top of sidetrack plug. Drilled CMT. To 2911 m. Commenced drilling 8 1/2" hole from 2911 m at 15/9-19bt2.
nan

Drilled surveyed to 1653m. Still fluctuations in pumping pressure. Backreamed and POOH, lots of cuttings from stabilizers/small cavings. Bit undergauge, 2 nozzles plugged with rubber from motor. Prepared new BHA.
RIH to 250m, tested MWD, negative, POOH, changed out MWD. RIH to 1485m, reamed to 1653m, drilled from 1653m to 1926m.
Drilled/surveyed 12 1/4" hole from 1926m to 2357m.
Drilled 12 1/4" hole to 1502m. Back-reamed to 13 3/8" shoe. Ran in to 2502m. Drilled 12 1/4" hole to 2559m.
Drilled/surveyed 12 1/4" hole from 2559m to 2938m
Drilled/surveyed 12 1/4" hole from 2938m to 3018m. Backreamed to 2957m. Hole packed off. Lost circulation. Pumped LCM-PILL. Reestablished circulation. Started backreaming OOH.
Backreamed to 2937, packed off, unable to rotate. Reestablished rotation and circulation. Pumped pills to clean hole. Raised mudweight to 1,45 then to 1,50 to control overpressured shales
Circulated to record/observe cuttings returns. Raised mudweight to 1,55 SG to control overpressured shales. Backreamed to 2850m.
Backreamed from 2850m to 2608m.
from 2608m to 2320m. hole and increased mudweight to 1. 6 s. G. from 2320m to 1590m. hole clean due to large amounts of cuttings in returns. from 1590m to 1475m.
from 1475m to 950m. ester mud from rig floor. new 12 1/4" BHA and RIH to 2740m. from 2740m to 2780m. from 2780m to 2903m.
RIH from 2903m to 2965m. from 2965m to 3018m. from 3018m to 3050m. from 3050m to 2130m.
backreaming out of hole. drill bit. Rechecked alignment of MWD and mudmotor. to shoe. and cut drilline. RIH to 2925m. down from 2925m to 3050m. to get survey, NEG. 12 1/4" hole from 3050m to 3052m.
down mud motor. BOP up new bit and mud motor. to 2207m.
RIH from 2207m to 3050m. 12 1/4" hole from 3050m to 3137m. Had problems with readings from MWD. to 2990m. hole clean. to 2738m.
to 2500m. to 3137m. 12 1/4" hole from 3137m to 3141m. tool failed. to change MWD tool. with new assembly and hung off same due to bad weather. riser to seawater. O. W.

O. W. rig back over template. drillstring. upper racking arm. from 1343m to 3141m. problems with MWD tool signals. 12 1/4" hole from 3141m to 3157m. MWD signal problem. 12 1/4" hole from 3157m to 3168m from 3166-3168m)

12 1/4" hole from 3168m to 3174m. 12 1/4" hole from 3174m to 3188m. to get survey. NEG. 12 1/4" hole from 3188m to 3195m. from 3195m to 3198m, had problems with MWD tool. 12 1/4" hole from 3198m to 3202m. from 3202m to 3204m, had problems with MWD tool. to 2898m and circulated well clean. Changed out transducer on top of standpipe. to 2500m and tested out MWD equipment. Everything OK. to 3204m. to

Performed repair work on aft PRS upper drive. Meanwhile laid out TCP guns, tested siemens/esd system and lifted xmas tree to moonpool.

Performed repair work on aft PRS upper drive. Waited on improved weather condictions for continuing repair work. Meanwhile tested DCI hose, installed debris caps on wellheads and attempted to inject slop in f-12 annulus.
Waited for weather condtions to improve for resuming aft PRS repair work.
Repaired aft PRS. Secured FWD PRS. Removed scaffolding from derrick.

Calibrated rig equipment after power shut down(s). Resumed well claning operation and RIH with cleaning string. Scraped and cleaned packer setting areas as required. Dressed of 7" liner PBR. Displaced well to 1,03 SG packer fluid. Flowchecked well. POOH with cleaning string to 3200 m MD.

POOH with cleaning string to 2175 m MD. Halted operation due to ongoing ESD testing. Tested ibops. Performed ESD testing. Re-set rig equipment after power shut down. POOH with cleaning string from 2175 m to 735 m MD.

POOH with cleaning string. Broke out and laid down 3 1/2" singles. Flushed c/k lines and manifold. Pulled bowl protector. Set 10 3/4" MS seal and tested same. Tested tie-back casing negative observed excessive pressure drop. Troubleshot situation. Leak tested line up OK. Pressurised well in stepwise manner and verified leak in tie-back string at around 200 bar. Started pressure test of 18 3/4" sur

Tested BOP. Pulled test plug. RIH with cup tester and tested upper tie-back string. Fingerprinted trip tanks. Leak tested tie-back and recorded leakage rates. Set nominal bowl protector. Waited on RTTS to arrive on supply boat.

Troubleshot leakage in tie-back string. Ran 9 5/8" RTTS and tested above and below tie-back stinger identified leakage to be in the sealstem/pbr. Established leakage rates. POOH with 9 5/8" RTTS packer.
Waited on plan of action from town. Wow prior to picking up perforation guns. Ran 4 1/2" perforation guns from surface to 252 m MD.

Ran 4 1/2" perforation guns from 252 to 862 m MD. Discussed plan of action with town. POOH 4 1/2" perforation guns from 862 m to surface. Flushed and tested lines for pressure testing 10 3/4" x 14" barrier envelope.
Waited for plan of action from town. Tested bultibowl BT-SEALS to 220 bar/10 min. Wow.

Attempted to pressure test 10 3/4" x 14" annulus, but found blocked communication port in wellhead. Tested shear ram while waiting for tubing puncher equipment and schlumberger personnel to arrive on the rig.
Waited for tubing puncher equipment and personnel to arrive on the rig. Spotted and RU WL equipment.

Continued to RU wireline equipment. RIH with tubing puncher. Punched holes in 9 5/8" CSG to get communication to 10 3/4" x 14" annulus. POOH. Pressure tested 10 3/4" x 14" annulus and wellhead to 220 bar 10 min. MU perforation guns to 54 m MD.
Ran TCP perforation guns to 173 m MD. POOH with TCP guns. Pressure tested 10 3/4" x 14" annulus and wellhead to 220 bar 10 min. Ran TCP perforation guns to 1311 m MD.
Repaired PRS racking arm. Ran perforation guns from 1311 m to 3303 m MD. Correlated guns with PBR no-go. Sat MAXR gun hanger. POOH with MAXR setting tool on 5 1/2" DP from 3305 to 1802 m MD.

POOH with MAXR setting tool on 5 1/2" DP from 1802 to OOH. Pulled bowl protector and washed surface wellhead and BOP. Prepared for running completion string. MU and RIH with completion assemblies. Wow due to high winds up to 71 knots and crane not able to PU DHSV.
MU and tested DHPG and chemical injection mandrel. Ran 7" tubing from 110 m to 625 m MD.
Ran 7" tubing from 625 to 1620 m MD.
Ran 7" tubing from 1620 to DHSV assembly. MU DHSV and connected and tested CL to 570 bar/10 min.

RIH with 7" tubing from 2528 m to 3023 m MD. Landed tubing at 3030. 6 m and performed space-out. Pulled back and installed space-out pup. MU th and terminated cls, chemical injection line and cable terminated at th. Prepared for MU communication collar.
MU th running tool. RIH and landed and tested the th. Performed low pressure test and function tested of DHSV. Sat production packer and tested tubing. Inflow tested DHSV. Started RU wireline.
RU wireline. RIH and retrieved NPR plug. POOH to 2970 m mdrkb.

Worked NPR pulling string to be able to pass production PBR at 2972 m. Attempted to change seal stem position in sheared PBR by applying 100/200 bar on annulus. No sucess. Performed 35/345 bar 10 min pressure test of tubing and production packer from below. Worked NPR pulling string with 345 bar on tubing to change seal stem position in PBR. No sucess. RIH to TCP gun hanger at 3089 m and freed GS
Retrieved the NPR plug, no damage or marks on the NPR plug. RD wire line surface equipment.
Retrieved landing string. Installed BPV. Nippled down BOP and riser. Installed dart in BPV. Terminated control lines. Installed extension spool.
Installed the WH extension spool, xmas tree and the production CO-FLEX hose.
Leak tested x-mas tree connections to 30/345 bars 5/10 min. Lined up and leak tested production line 50/180 bars 5/10 min. Inflow tested LMV and HMV against BPV.
Sent firing command to e-fire firing head in TCP guns and perforated well from 3130 to 3281 mmdrt.

Handed well over from production. RU HMV and DHSV to local control panel. Installed test and bleed manifold on to XMT KWV. Performed line test from KWV to CMT unit. Attempted to leak tested XMT cross to 30/200 bar for 5/10 min.

Operated and greased up leaking PWV. Leak tested XMT cross to 30/200 bar for 5/10 min. Installed WL BOP and riser on XMT. Tested shear seals on WL BOP. Installed combination toolstring in riser. MU lubricator. Leak test WL riser, BOP and lubricator. Equalize and open HMV and DHSV. RIH with combination toolstring and tagged TCP guns at 3260. 5 m. Performed correlation log in 7" liner. POOH and prep

Inflow tested HMV to 81-5 bar/10 min. Broke lubricator and LD toolstring. Installed PLT toolstring in riser. MU lubricator and leak tested at in-situ sub. Equalized and opened HMV. RIH with PLT toolstring on 7/16" EWL from surface to 2929 m. Performed stationary logging at DHPG depth. Continued RIH from 2929 m to 3030 m to perform shut-in station logs and 4 PLT tool calibration passes in the inter

Choked back flow to 1500 sm3/day. Performed station logs and 4 low rate flowing PLT passes in the interval 3030 m to 3255 m MD. Shut-in well. POOH with PLT toolstring. Inflow tested DHSV, HMV and MMV for handover. Bo lubricator and LD toolstring. LD lubricator. RD and LD WL riser.

RD BOP from XMT. Leak test XMT cross, KWV and tree cap. Hand well over to m rsk production. Cleared and cleaned rig floor of remaining WL equipment. Transferred operation to f-99 for PRS-AND 5-yearly BOP classification.
Waited on access to well. Took over well. Rigged up WL riser and BOP.

RU WL equipment. Installed BHA into lubricator. RIH with PLT. Performed spinner calibration. Performed depth correlation with GR/CCL. Took stationary reading at 2929 m. Ran PLT shut in pass. Took stationary readings. Beaned up well. Waited for stable flow.

Waited for stable flow aprox. 5050 sm3/d with PLT at 3080 m. Attempted to RIH at various speed. No-go. Reduced flow rate to 3000 sm3/d. Took stationary readings at 3080, 3155, 3200 and 3250 m. Logged flowing passes between 3030 and 3250 m, down at 40 m/min and up at 10/20/30/40 m/min. Reduced flow rate to 1500 sm3/d. Logged flowing passes between 3000 and 3250 m, down at 40 m/min and up at 10/20/3
Installed 5,72" EVO bridge plug at 3210 m mid element. RD wireline pressure control equipment and handed well over to production department.
Spotted some equpment. Waited on weather, wind above 40 knots.
Spotted WL equipment. Checked equipment together with rig electrician.
Spotted equipment. Well handed over from production dept. To d&w. Started to rig up on wellhead.

Completed rigging up wireline equipment. Leak tested rig up to 20/345 bar. Run in hole with halliburton EVO plug. Pulled out of hole after tool failure at 1400 m. Started to prepare back up toolstring.
Installed 7" ev0 plug with mid element at 3150 m. Perforated new zone from 3126,2 mmd. POOH with perforating gun.
POOH with perfoartion gun. Inflow tested well barriers. Rigged down WL equipment. Operation completed.

Skidded rig to f-14. Continued changing wires on aft PRS and attempted to change DCI hose, but operation postponed due to weather. Removed hatches and built scaffolding around hatches on all levels. Waited on weather for cranes to pick up cart and BHA.

Wow. Changed wash pipe. Racked cart STD. MU and RIH with 36" ho BHA to 143 m. Stung into funnel assisted by ROV. Tagged sea BTM and drilled 36" hole from 145. 7 m to 193 m MD using SW and hi-vis pills.

Drilled 36" hole from 193 m to 204 m MD. Circulated well clean and displaced to 1. 40 SG bentonite mud. POOH and LD 36" ho BHA. Wow due to no crane operation. MU and RIH with 30" conductor until x-over joint. Started to install UWG top-up system on upper 35 m.
Changed to 5 1/2" handling equipment. MU 30" conductor housing joint. Wow.
Wow.
Wow. Made up CMT stinger inside 30" conductor. Run 30" conductor and stabbed same into template guide funnel. Run 30" conductor to 169 m. Washed down from 169 m.

Run 30" conductor, washed down from 169 m to TD at 196. 8 m. Verified TD with digiquartz measurements. Circulated prior to cement job. Observed returns came up on 30" x 13 3/8" annulus on well f-7. Took time out to evaluate situation. Wow due to bad visibillity on sea bed.

Wow for visibility to improve on template. Engage hot-stab for centraliser system and operated the rams for f-14 and retracted same. Circulated SW at 250 LPM increased to 1000 LPM in 250 LPM steps. Still only returns coming out from f-7. Pumped 30 m 1. 7 SG mud, 1000 LPM, 5. 7 bars 85 MT string weight. Still only returns out from f-7. Picked up one meter with 120 MT and washed conductor back to se

Displaced cement slurry with 6. 5 m of SW. Waited on cement to set. Meanwhile performed general maintenance. Lined up for flushing of top-up line.

Pressure tested UWG top-up system using the cement unit, rupture disk burst at 53 bars psi). Performed cement top-up job, pumped 10. 4 m 1. 56 SG g-cement 82 bars at 500 LPM. Drilled 26" hole from 206 m to 211 m MD. Pulled BHA to thighten UBHO sleeve. RIH with BHA. Waited for work on siemens system. Drilled 26" hole from 211 to 269 m MD, steered as required. Performed gyro single shot survey on each single drilled.
Drilled 26" hole section from 269 m MD to 636 m MD. Steered according to planned wellpath.
Drilled 26" hole from 636 m to TD at 1083 m MD. Circ hole clean with hi sweeps.

Continued RU CSG running equipment. MU and ran 20" casing to 414 m MD.

Continued installing DCI assembly on WH housing. RIH and land 20" casing. Circulate, pump and displace cement. Release cart and POOH. LD cart. Clear drill floor. Skidded rig to f-9.
Skidded cantilever to f-14. Prepared rigged up HPDR spider and handling equipment. M/u HPDR TBC and double Function tested HPDR TBC. Running of HPDR suspended. Resumed maintenance of the aft PRS.
Skidded the cantilever to f-12 and f-14 for re-arranging hatch covers. Shut down production. Re-arranged hatch covers. Ran in with TBC and HPDR double and picked up HPDR double
Ran in with HPDR, landed and locked the HPDR. Made up the tension system.

Set nominal seat protector. Made up 17 1/2" BHA. RIH with 17 1/2" BHA and drilled 20" shoetrack.

Cleaned rathole and drilled 3 m new formation down to 1086 m MD. Pumped hi-vis sweep, displaced to 1,20 SG WBM and spotted LCM pill in rathole. Conditioned mud and performed fit to 1,38 EMW. Drilled 17 1/2" section down to 1302 m MD. Had problems with overflow on shakers and screen plugging.
Drilled 17 1/2" hole section from 1302 m to 1725 m MD.
Drilled 17 1/2" hole section from 1725 m to 2209 m MD.

Broke out and laid down 17 1/2" drilling BHA. Retrieved nominal seat protector. Worked on TDS to get right allignment relative to well centre. Rigged up 14" casing running equipment.
Rigged up 14" casing running equipment. Made repairs on BX elevator. Ran shoejoints and threadlocked. Ran 14" casing to 610 m MD.
Ran 14" 96,6# casing from 610 m to 2131 m MD. Picked up and made up 14" casing hanger padprt.

Rigged down casing running equipment. RIH with 14" casing/padprt on 5 1/2" HWDP. Washed down casing. Picked up cement head and landed casing at 2276 m MD. Pressure tested BOP and IBOP'S. Worked on allignment cylinder for TDS. Made up 12 1/4" drilling BHA. RIH 12 1/4" drilling BHA to 526 m MD. Perfomed shallow test on MWD. ROV worked to free CRI valve assy from mud/seabed.

RIH with 12 1/4" BHA from 526 m and tagged cement at 2248 m MD. Drilled cement plug and shoetrack. Cleaned out rathole and drilled 3 m new formation down to 2284 m MD. Perfomed XLOT. Displaced from WBM to OBM.
Drilled 12 1/4" hole section from 2284 m to 2666 m with limited ROP due to problems with MWD signal decoding.
Drilled 12 1/4" hole section from 2666 m to TD at 2788 m MD. Circulated hole clean and dropped gyro. POOH from 2785 m to 133 m. Removed gyro tool string and LD 12 1/4" BHA from 133 m to 88 m MD.

Continue LD 12 1/4" BHA from 88 m to OOH. Jetted wear bushing area and pulled wear bushing. Inspected top drive and derrick for loose items. RU 9 5/8" CSG running equipment. RIH with 9 5/8" CSG from surface to 339 m.
RIH with 9 5/8" CSG from 339 m to 1170 m. RU 10 3/4" CSG handling equipment and FAC tool. Installed 9 5/8" x 10 3/4" XO. RIH with 10 3/4" CSG from 1188 m to 1763 m.

RIH at 40 m to made second attempt to install lock down sub.

Leak tested RTTS to 230 bar from below. Displaced well to sea water above plug. POOH with RTTS running tool and LD same. ND and lo diverter.

ND slick joint and BOP. Ran in and MU claxton tool NT-2 running tool to HPDR. RD tension cylinders, tensioner ring and centralizer. Shut down production. Installed hot stab and unlocked TBC. Pulled TBC out of WH. Installed riser spider. POOH with HPDR. Started to brake upper flange on HPDR tension joint.
POOH with HPDR. Moved riser landing guide funnel from f-3 to f-14. Ran TBC and function tested same. Installed guide wires. Continued RIH with PR to 2nd double.
Continued RIH with PR. Landed riser and removed riser landing guiding funnel. Started production. Locked TBC and pressure tested PR against RTTS to 100 bar 10 min.

Retrieved guide wires for PR. Installed centralizers, boat collision stool, tensioner ring and tension cylinders in WH module. Shut down production on f-12 and installed hatches on f-13 and f-15. Transfered weight from TDS to tensioner system. Measured cutting hight on PR and RU cutting tool. Started cutting PR 1414 mm above tensioner deck.
Cut the PR and bevelled same. Installed the multibowl and valves. Installed BOP riser jnt. Built scaffolding to get access to BOP riser jnt connection. Changed wash pipe.
Tested the wash pipe IBOP to 20/345 bars 5/10 mins. Nippled up BOP and diverter and pressure tested same to 20/345 bars 5/10 mins. Performed slip and cut of drill line.

Tested BOP connection to 35/345 bars 5/10mins. Washed subsea well head. Rigged up casing handling equipment. RIH with 10 3/4" tie-back adapter on 10 3/4" casing and made up 10 3/4" surface casing hanger assembly.

Picked up spear assy and installed 10 3/4" casing, RIH and landed off in the subsea well head and made up same with 10,800 NM make up. Released spear and POOH. P/u and m/u adjustment sub setting tool. RIH and locked the adjustment sub. Attempted to come out with the adjustment sub setting tool.

Attempted to retrieve the adjustment sub setting tool with straight pull of 150 MT overpull. Retrieved 10 3/4" tie back and surface hanger with adjustment sub setting tool still inside. Installed plate and 5½" DP elevators on top of 10 3/4" surface hanger and secured same. Prepared to pull 10 3/4" with adjustment sub setting tool inside.

Pulled tie-back casing hanger. Retrieved adjustement sub setting tool. Picked up back up hanger. Installed 10 3/4" tie back casing and pressure tested same to 345 bars 10 mins. Installed 10 3/4" MS-T seal assy and tested same 345 bars 10 mins. Set 10 3/4" bowl protector. Prepared for retrieval of the RTTS. RIH with RTTS pulling tool from surface to 10m.
Retrieved RTTS plug at 349 m. Displaced well above RTTS plug to 1. 30 SG OBM. M/u 8½" drilling BHA. RIH with 8½" drilling BHA from surface to 1722m.

RIH with 8½" drilling BHA on 5½" DP. Tagged TOC at 2754m. Drilled out shoe track from 2754m to 2783m 3m new formation. Took fit equivalent 1. 56 SG, using 1. 30 SG heavy OBM. Continued drill 8½" hole from 2791m to 2850m.
Continued drilling 8½" hole from 2850m to 3070m. Increased MW from 1. 30 SG to 1. 35 SG. Prepared for taking pressure point with stethoscope.
Continued drilling 8½" hole from 3070m to 3335m. Took pressure points, bit depth 3031. 7m, 3042. 7m, 3056. 7m, 3185. 7m, 3140. 7m, 3203. 7m, 3225. 7m.
Continued drilling 8½" hole from 3335m to 3617m. Took pressure points.

POOH with 8½" drilling BHA from 1919m to 138m. Laid out 8½" drilling BHA. Rigged up and RIH with 7" liner from surface to 600m. Found overshot packer leaking.
Continued RIH with 7" liner from 600m to 1068m. Made up 7" liner hanger/packer. Continued RIH with 7" liner hanger/packer on 5½" DP from 1092m to 3685m.

Set the liner hanger at 2616. Circulated and cement 7" liner. Set packer. Circulated out excess cement. Released running tool, circulated and POOH. LD liner hanger running tool. Ran in with BOP/SURFACE well head clean out assy. And started cleaning the BOP/SURFACE well head.

Jet washed BOP/SURFACE well head. Performed BOP pressure test. Pressure tested the well/7" liner to 310 bars 10 min 1. 36 SG OBM. RIH w/cleaning assy. On 3 ½" DP from surface to 630m. 3½" DP ran singles from cantilever. Had problems with PDM, HTS roller and tail arm of HTS.
RIH with 7" x 9 5/8" x 10 3/4" well cleaning string. Scraped and cleaned FLX and production packer setting areas. Polished and dressed PBR. Conditioned mud.

Conditioned mud. Displaced string to baseoil and inflow tested liner. Started well washing. Aborted well washing due to leaking wash pipe. Exchanged wash pipe. Resumed displacement operation, pumped wash pills followed by seawater and packer fluid. Tested casing/liner to 35/345 bar OK. Flowchecked welll. Mixed more packer fluid.
POOH with 7"x 9 5/8" x 10 3/4" cleaning string. Laid down 3 singles when pulling out. Retrieved bowl protector. Prepared for running tubing.
Made up th landing string. Rigged up for running tubing. Spotted control line reels. Made up and ran completion assemblies. Terminated DHPG and chemical injection valve. Ran 7" tubing to 240 m MD.
Ran 7" tubing from 240 m to 1250 m MD. Installed assy#4 GLV. Ran 7" tubing from 1260 m to 1400 m MD.

Terminated control lines above ASV, tested lines as required. Made up DHSV with specail clamps, hooked up control line and tested same. RIH with 7" tubing from 2108 m to 2596 m MD. Picked up landing stand. RIH and tagged top of PBR at 2615,4 m MD. Performed tubing space out.

Terminated control lines in tubing hanger. Made up THRT landing string. Displaced 10 m3 baseoil in to tubing. RIH and landed th at 20,45 m MD. Tested th. Performed low pressure tests. Set production packer and tested tubing. Inflow tested DHSV.
Tested a-annulus and set FLX packer. Inflow tested ASV. Released THRT, pulled and broke landing string. Set BPV. Nippled down diverter and BOP. Prepared to pull BOP riser.

Nippled down BOP riser. Removed comm collar, pulled control lines through WH and tested pentrations. Installed and tested XMT spool. Installed and tested XMT connection. Filled coflex hose. Retieved BPV/DART. Made up chemical injection manifold to wellhead. Tested chemical injection line. Inflow tested LMV and HMV. Commissioned XMT. Meanwhile prepared for WL operations and performed rig maintenance.
Commissioned XMT. Meanwhile prepared for running WL and performed rig maintenance.
Commissioned XMT. Performed line test. Hooked up local control on XMT.
Leak test rig up 30/185 bar 5/10 min. RIH with perforation run#1 on WL to 3400 m. Correlated to shooting depth. Trouble shoot schlumberger communication problem with downhole tools.

RIH with BHA and perforate interval on WL and tractor. Sucess. Rig up BHA RIH and perforation interval on WL and tractor.

Started changing wires on PRS. Skidded rig to f-14.

RIH with 7" tubing from 2164 m to 2661 m MD. Entered 7" liner PBR with lower most seal on seal stem at 2664. 3 m. Spaced out tubing. Installed tubing hanger. Terminated control line.
